answer_1.quote: We propose an approach to automatically generate counter-claims from a given claim using two steps: 1) select salient words from the true claim... and 2) replace those words with their opposites using Masked Language Model infilling with entailment-based quality control.
answer_1.outputs: Counter-claims generated from true claims via salient word replacement

answer_3.quote: To compute the contradiction score we use the RoBERTa model trained on Multi-NLI due to its size and diversity.

answer_4.quote: We presented 150 randomly selected claims to Amazon Mechanical Turk workers. Annotators were presented with the original claim and five generated candidate counter-claims... They were then asked if those claims are implied by the original claim...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judged whether candidate counter-claims were implied by the original claim.
